candidates.formal_type:
∀ {n : Nat} {adj : Matrix.{0, 0, 0} (Fin n) (Fin n) Int},
  Etingof.IsDynkinDiagram n adj →
    ∀ (α : Fin n → Int),
      Etingof.IsPositiveRoot n adj α →
        ∀ (k : Type u) [inst : Field.{u} k] {Q : Quiver.{0, 0} (Fin n)},
          Etingof.IsOrientationOf.{0} Q adj →
            ∀ [∀ (a b : Fin n), Subsingleton.{1} (Quiver.Hom.{0, 0} a b)],
              Exists.{u + 2} fun ρ =>
                Exists.{0} fun x =>
                  Exists.{0} fun x =>
                    And (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.IsIndecomposable.{u, 0, 0, u} ρ)
                      (∀ (v : Fin n),
                        Eq.{1} (α v)
                          (Nat.cast.{0} (Module.finrank.{u, u} k (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.obj.{u, 0, u, 0} ρ v))))

source_text: Every positive root of a chosen Dynkin orientation is realized by an indecomposable representation.
